hardware.statistic_method: Median averages the two middle sorted values for even N; p95 uses nearest-rank ceil(0.95*N)-1; threshold is strictly greater than 33.333ms. Stored report summaries agree within 1e-8ms.

caveats: All source/browser/hardware counts in this receipt belong to bf1131998d2cc72fdaadc1d7dc40d0dca3ccb0c0 / eeb4448629f212edc539c265ea6b05b890ae548227795b3ba2ceae76c01c5a6a. They do not establish verification or footage for the later 92fb503c UI build.
Python reports 54 tests, including one explicit Windows symlink-privilege skip. It is inaccurate to call all 54 executed passes or to claim the Linux CI symlink test was independently inspected here.

Hardware cadence consists of five ~3-second perspective samples totaling ~14.9993 seconds. It does not measure sustained GPU throughput, thermal behavior, percentile latency for the entire tour, or performance in every camera/region.
The bow run has no RAF samples. No independent bow frame-time statistic is supported by its report.

The bow report reuses method prose describing a five-road tour, swimming and a Heaven objective. Its variant and 13 actual event names show a Hell bow-combat run only. That generic prose is not a supported description of bow scope.
Guarded sequences record player HP100 to96; without an unguarded comparator these records do not quantify the amount of damage avoided by guard.

All impact snapshots report projectiles0 after damage. This does not independently establish projectile flight appearance or travel timing, although the bow-labelled impact sequence and actual enemy defeat are recorded.
Reported footage-span timestamps are not an independently measured media duration. Video files were hashed, not decoded or watched in this audit.
canonical_ownership_preserved is a report field; this audit verified identities and arithmetic, not every intermediate save mutation.

Both hardware reports explicitly set human_acceptance=false and sustained_performance_qualification=false. Automated actions, passed software gates, sample cadence and file identities do not establish human feel, accessibility qualification, deployment, remote reproducibility, or whole-video quality.
